content.short: GME is a gaming-focused decentralized NFT marketplace on the Ethereum blockchain.
content.description: GameStop launched in October as a gaming-focused decentralized marketplace on Ethereum, developed in partnership with Immutable X. The platform currently enables trading of artwork and collectibles minted on the Ethereum network, with on-chain provenance for these assets. It also provides a browser extension that functions as a non-custodial crypto wallet, allowing users to buy and store NFTs securely in their own custody. Together, these features pair a decentralized marketplace with a non-custodial wallet, enabling direct interaction with Ethereum-based NFTs without relying on a central party.
